model: EfficientNet B0 FP32, 1-channel input, 2 classes, seeded random local weights
scope: Actual Studio engine inference_sec: file read/decode, crop/resize/normalize, model and numerical postprocessing. Grad-CAM disabled. Excludes setup, preview, GUI and disk cache.
note: Each run uses a separate process, serially. Repeated same seeded RGB PNG, decoded to gray. File cache is warm during repeated timings. No target-PC or accuracy claim.
first_button_note: One actual desktop process button run on a different seeded grayscale PNG. Inference 11.527 ms, including first-file decode 4.476 ms; retained as evidence that warm p95 is not a first-image guarantee.
